seed.description: In sectionsByTitle, the trailing-newline normalization changed from /\r?\n$/ to /\r?$/. The regex no longer removes the final \n of a released section, so a section that differs from base only by a missing final newline is reported as edited. This is a realistic regex-edit slip (a dropped escape) and breaks the commit's own test 'ignores a missing terminal newline when comparing released sections'.
